en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a narrow country road winding through a forested mountain valley. On the left, rocky cliffs rise beside the road, where a man drives a horse-drawn carriage away from the viewer. On the right, a small stream runs alongside the road through dense conifer trees. At the top in red German text it reads 'Aus Komotau's Umgebung. Grundtalstraße.' indicating the rural surroundings and a specific valley road near Komotau.
